title: Query Complexity of Learning Axis-Aligned Partitions
abstract: arXiv:2610.35495v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work establishes the query complexity of learning high-dimensional boxes in the exact query learning setting. Let $X \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ be a set of $n$ points, labeled by a collection of $k$ boxes: the label of each point in $X$ is determined by the unique box containing it. A learner aims to exactly recover the labels for every point in $X$ given access to a label oracle. We consider three increasingly-structured settings. In the most general setting, there are no conditions on the boxes, and they may overlap. We show that CAL (Cohn-Atlas-Ladner 1994), a classical active learning algorithm, is minimax-optimal with query complexity $\Theta(kd \log (n/kd))$. When the boxes are disjoint, we examine two regimes. In the large-$k$ regime, CAL remains minimax-optimal. translated_title: 轴对齐划分学习的查询复杂度
translated_abstract: 本工作确立了在精确查询学习设定下学习高维盒子的查询复杂度。设 $X \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ 是一个由 $n$ 个点组成的集合，由 $k$ 个盒子的集合进行标注：$X$ 中每个点的标签由包含它的唯一盒子确定。学习者的目标是在能够访问标签预言机的情况下，精确恢复 $X$ 中每个点的标签。我们考虑三种结构化程度递增的设定。在最一般的设定下，盒子没有任何条件限制，且可以相互重叠。我们证明了经典主动学习算法 CAL（Cohn-Atlas-Ladner 1994）是极小极大最优的，其查询复杂度为 $\Theta(kd \log (n/kd))$。当盒子互不相交时，我们考察了两种情形。在大 $k$ 情形下，CAL 仍然保持极小极大最优。对于常数 $k$ 情形，Halving 算法（Hegedűs 1995）的一个优化变体可以比 CAL 优越一个 $\log(d)$ 因子。最后，在结构化程度最高的设定下……
tldr: 本文确立了精确查询学习设定下学习高维轴对齐盒子划分的查询复杂度，证明了经典主动学习算法 CAL 在一般设定下具有极小极大最优的查询复杂度 $\Theta(kd \log (n/kd))$，并在盒子互不相交的常数 $k$ 情形下给出了能超越 CAL 一个 $\log(d)$ 因子的 Halving 算法优化变体。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the query complexity of learning high-dimensional axis-aligned box partitions in exact query learning, proving that the classical active learning algorithm CAL is minimax-optimal with query complexity $\Theta(kd \log (n/kd))$ in the general setting, and showing that an optimized Halving variant can beat CAL by a $\log(d)$ factor in the constant-k disjoint-boxes regime.
